faq.q: How do I install Coin Master on Android?
faq.a: Open Google Play, search for Coin Master and check the developer is Moon Active before tapping Install. It needs Android 7.0 or newer. It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. Avoid copies from other sites: they aren't from Moon Active and may be altered, so the safest way to play Coin Master is the official listing.
Yes. Coin Master is free to download and play, and it contains ads. Google Play lists in-app purchases from $0.49 to $374.99 per item, mainly spins and coins.

faq.q: How do I get free spins in Coin Master?
faq.a: Spins refill over time, and you can get more from daily rewards, events, friends' gifts, watching ads and the official free spins links Moon Active shares on its social media accounts, which open directly in the game.

faq.q: Why is Coin Master rated Teen?
faq.a: Google Play rates Coin Master Teen for simulated gambling, because its main feature is spinning a slot machine. You can't win real money, but it uses the same reward mechanics as gambling, which some parents may want to avoid.

faq.q: How do card collections work in Coin Master?
faq.a: You find cards in chests, which are bought with coins or earned in events. Completing a set of cards gives spins and pets, and completing every set in a season gives big rewards.
